name: code/tests-python
title: pytest tests for an existing module
summary: pytest starter for an existing module: fixtures, parametrised cases and tmp_path use.
when: Use when the user already has a Python module or script and wants a pytest suite around it.

module.about: Import name of the module under test, without .py (lowercase identifier).

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project next to the module, rename the imports and cases to match its real functions, then run python3 -m pytest -q.
